capabilities: Restore cursor and scroll position per note on reopen
Navigate back and forward through cursor positions across notes with Alt+Left/Alt+Right
Record positions left when switching tabs or following links into new tabs
Deduplicate and filter history entries with configurable thresholds
Configure history size, thresholds, data file path, and save timing
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese settings UI; ships as a manual download option in addition to the community plugin listing.
intentEvidence: Fork of dy-sh/remember-cursor-position by Dmitry Savosh, with significant enhancements.
problem: Obsidian reopens notes without restoring where you were reading or typing, and there is no cursor-level back/forward history across files and tabs.

relations.evidence: Fork of dy-sh/remember-cursor-position by Dmitry Savosh, with significant enhancements.

summary: Fork of Remember Cursor Position that restores each note's cursor and scroll spot and adds VS Code-style global back/forward cursor history (Alt+Left/Right).
